need: Roof detection should not return a 0-cell footprint when wall openings are 3+ blocks wide; fall back to the bounding box of full-height columns or raise a readable error instead of crashing the preset with 'Reduce of empty array'.
evidence: --detect reported 0-cell footprint on walls with 3+ block openings (stall bays); --preset desert crashed; builder passed --footprint/--y by hand.

need: Tower material, slit/opening pattern and beam-end options on the CLI, not only the --tower box; presets should honour --material/--trim on their own tower and coping.
evidence: Desert preset tower is deepslate bricks with quartz cap, one hole per face; no material/slit/viga option; preset's tower and coping ignore --material/--trim.

need: Preset palettes should avoid outlier blocks (smooth_quartz, mud_brick flagged by mcd palette) or the preset should pass the palette check before emitting.
evidence: Deck and coping used smooth_quartz and mud_brick (outlier flags); builder swapped them with a hand-written replace loop.

need: A striped awning brush: colour pair, slope, depth, post spacing and valance, usable over any row of bays, with a stair/slab fallback for blocks lacking stairs.
evidence: No brush for striped cloth awning; builder hand-placed 2 rows of red_sandstone/smooth_quartz stairs; terracotta and wool have no stairs so stripes approximated.

need: Place a row of protruding beam ends (log with axis, 1-block projection, even spacing) under a parapet or eave on every face.
evidence: Vigas read as dark cubes/crates; no brush; builder hand-placed dark_oak_log along each wall. Closest brackets/fins don't give beam ends.

need: Round wall corners and parapet edges (adobe softness) via a 'rounded' style in setbacks/parapet, using stairs or slabs at corners.
evidence: Hard rectangular box with sharp corners; no rounded style on setbacks/parapet; builder used buttress piers with slab caps.

need: Ribbed or banded dome option with a ring-colour parameter, so a stepped/banded dome doesn't come out as a squat terraced stack.
evidence: dome radius 3 height 2 came out as squat terraced stack; no ribbed/banded option; only drum block as orange band.

tool: prop brush (pots, composters, barrels, hay bales)
need: A prop brush placing grouped decorative props (pots, barrels, composters, hay bales) by the door or along a wall, with grouping and matched materials.
evidence: Pots and clutter scattered; builder used g.set by hand; planter only does flowers in a box, fixture only lanterns.

need: A connected fence/rail run helper that sets north/south/east/west connection states along a span automatically.
evidence: B.fence() returns an unconnected fence; builder hand-wrote per-cell connection states.

need: A wide single-row name board / sign band that lays readable text across multiple sign blocks without needing 2+ rows.
evidence: signboard over 1-row band gave tiny text; plaque needs 2+ rows; BAZAAR board read as '8-ZAAN' and clipped at edge.

need: arch(frame:) and surround arch must work on a 2-thick wall alongside carved openings and a lintel, so portal heads become true arches not rectangular blocks.
evidence: arch(frame:) unusable after carving stalls and setting a lintel; hand-placed corbel stairs; portal head still reads as rectangular block; surround arch untried on 2-thick wall.

tool: mcd paint weather / vary on sandstone
need: Weathering and vary passes should draw only from the material's own family (sandstone variants) and never introduce foreign-looking greys like granite.
evidence: mcd paint weather light and vary subtle on sandstone introduced grey granite-like stray speckles; removed.

need: Renders should make sign and banner text legible at card scale so a judge can tell whether a name board reads correctly.
evidence: Judge saw '8-ZAAN' with malformed letters and clipped last letter; the card cannot confirm legibility at review scale.
